column1: # Seven marks only: atac h3k4me3 h3k27ac h3k27me3 h3k9me3 h3k36me3 h3k4me1
# H3K9ac and DNase are not model inputs.
# Notes must start with '#' or they are parsed as picks.
# ROUTE B: accessibility comes from snATAC BAMs, converted locally with one
# fixed command, so MCF-10A can stay as the breast context. Use mark 'atac_bam'
# for those; 'atac' still means a ready-made fold-change bigWig.
# MCF-10A must be re-converted with the SAME command as the others -- the
# existing data/reference/ATAC_seq.bw used unrecorded parameters and cannot be
# matched, so it is not reused here.
# h3k9ac    ENCFF110TAI    not a model input
# ENCFF113XMQ was the original H3K4me3 pick, rejected as hg19
#   atac_bam  ENCFF021PIS    MCF 10A snATAC, re-converted with the same command
